label: Arborist looks
summary: How Arborist draws what it is handed: the looks of its items and its system's settings, set per course in its arborist-species.json. Who draws which tree is the routing (vegetation-rules.json `routing`).
steps: Each Arborist item is a clone of its species out of the GolfMap library, in the looks of `treeSettings` (trees) and `plantSettings` (the lower vegetation): rules by name, later ones winning; a tree model's own look (models.json) goes on top.
The lower vegetation (bushes, ground plants) comes from the zone masks and the grass palette's items: `species` maps or drops their prefabs.
`vegeSettings` go into the file's system settings, which GSPro's Arborist system runs with.

rules.text: The trees' looks: tints, caps, billboard calibration, LOD factor, by name match.
The lower vegetation's looks, by name match.
The Arborist species of a lower-vegetation prefab the name rule misses (null = left out).
How far out Arborist draws the lower vegetation.
